draft_metadata.classification_reason: 研究主体为摩拉链霉菌 (Streptomyces mobaraensis) 的内源 I-E 型 CRISPR-Cas 系统表征、工具化与代谢工程应用；其核心贡献是面向链霉菌底盘建立了一套可直接复用的内源 CRISPR 基因组编辑平台，并以此提高 TGase 这一工业酶种的产量与制品安全性；因此核心分类为'细胞工厂/09. 链霉菌与其他细菌'，相关分类上'基因编辑工具/01. CRISPR 系统开发'契合方法学贡献、'代谢工程/08. 工业酶高产菌株'契合产量提升的应用面。

Figure 1d/e 中各 PAM 在两次生物学重复中的具体柱高数值未在正文逐条罗列，正文仅给出 5′-AAC-3′ 显著低于阴性对照的定性结论，无法从缩放图中精确判读其它 8 个候选 PAM 的具体接合子数。
Figure 4 的 LC-MS 仅给出 m/z 487.1896 (pseudouridimycin) 与 m/z 416.2795 (piericidin A1) 的提取离子流图，未提供二级质谱碎片或 NMR 等独立结构验证数据。

minor_issues.issue: Fig 3b 中各突变株的 TGase 活性具体 U/mL 数值（如 IPIO2Δ42 ≈ 57.6、其余三株 ≈ 52.7、WT ≈ 48.6）系从柱形图视觉读数估算，原文仅给出 18.5% 与 8.5% 百分比，未明示绝对值；建议在报告中标注为图读估值或仅保留百分比表述。
Fig 3b 与 Fig 3d 中各柱上方具体显著性星号数（∗∗∗、∗、∗∗、∗∗ 与 ∗）需由读者从图像判读，原文 caption 仅提供图例说明、未逐株标明 p 值；如要保留具体星号表述，宜注明'据图判读'。
Fig 4b 标签排版错误已被解读正确识别（图标注 pum-in-F/R=828 bp、pum-out-F/R=738 bp，而 caption 写 pum-out-F/R=828 bp），报告选择以 caption 为准并明示差异，但措辞可更明确为'作者原图内部不一致'，以免读者误以为是解读修正。

verified_claims.claim: 内源 I-E 型 CRISPR-Cas 系统功能性 PAM 为 5′-AAC-3′，通过 spacer 15 与 spacer 10 双靶干扰实验确证
verified_claims.evidence: identifying the protospacer adjacent motif as 5′-AAC-3′ … The plasmid harboring the PAM 5′-AAC-3′ and spacer 15 showed significantly lower transformation efficiency … A similar reduction was observed for the plasmid harboring the PAM 5′-AAC-3′ and spacer 10

verified_claims.claim: 单基因（tg）缺失编辑效率 70%（pCRISPR-tg-1 与 pCRISPR-tg-2 各 7/10）
verified_claims.evidence: achieving 70% for single-gene deletions … For both pCRISPR-tg-1 and pCRISPR-tg-2, seven out of 10 transformants (70%) produced a short DNA band of the expected size (~460 bp)

verified_claims.claim: 10–40 kb 大片段缺失效率 75–80%（pum BGC 11.8 kb：3/4；pie BGC 40 kb：4/5）
verified_claims.evidence: 75–80% for large DNA fragment deletions ranging from 10 to 40 kb … 75% of the transformants (3/4) showed successful deletion of the pum BGC … 80% of the transformants (4/5) showed successful deletion of the 40-kb fragment of the pie BGC

verified_claims.claim: TGase 产量提高 8.5%–18.5%（SMDS_42 缺失 18.5%；SMDS_1044/1045、SMDS_1204、SMDS_957 缺失各约 8.5%）
verified_claims.evidence: enhanced TGase production by 8.5–18.5% … the inactivation of SMDS_42 led to an 18.5% increase in TGase yield, and the simultaneous deletion of SMDS_1044 and SMDS_1045 and individual deletions of SMDS_1204 and SMDS_957 resulted in an approximately 8.5% increase in yield

verified_claims.claim: IPIO2 Δpum Δpie 较亲本 TGase 增产 17%，生物量无显著差异
verified_claims.evidence: resulting in a 17% increase in TGase yield … The pum and pie BGC-deleted mutant, IPIO2 Δpum Δpie, exhibited a 17% increase in TGase yield compared with that of the parental IPIO2 strain … with no apparent difference in cell growth

verified_claims.claim: Round 2 质粒消除后 pCRISPR-tg-1–1 来源菌落 100% 保持 tg 缺失型，对照 1278-tg-1 仅 52.6%
verified_claims.evidence: All 19 colonies (100%) derived from pCRISPR-tg-1–1 transformants retained the tg-deleted genotype … approximately half (10/19, 52.6%) of the colonies derived from control 1278-tg-1 transformants exhibited the desired tg deletion

verified_claims.claim: IPIO2 含 8 个 cas 基因（cas3-cas8-cas11-cas7-cas5-cas6-cas1-cas2）与 19 个 29-bp 重复、18 条平均 32-bp spacer，RNA-seq 确认 8 个 cas 均转录活跃
verified_claims.evidence: The cas genes, including cas3, cas8, cas11, cas7, cas5, cas6, cas1, and cas2 … all eight cas genes were transcriptionally active during fermentation … The CRISPR array consists of 19 conserved 29-bp repeats … interspersed with 18 unique spacers (average length of 32 bp)

verified_claims.claim: IPIO2 基因组含 104,062 个 5′-AAC-3′ 位点，平均每基因 15.8 个
verified_claims.evidence: the S. mobaraensis IPIO2 genome was found to contain 104,062 5′-AAC-3′ sites, with an average of 15.8 sites per gene

verified_claims.claim: 假尿苷霉素（pum BGC, cluster 1）与吡啶霉素 A1（pie BGC, cluster 29，约 50 kb）经 antiSMASH 与 LC-MS 鉴定，分子离子分别为 m/z 487.1896 [M+H]⁺ 与 m/z 416.2795 [M+H]⁺
verified_claims.evidence: Pseudouridimycin is a nucleoside analog antibiotic … (pum BGC, cluster 1) … piericidin A1 … (pie BGC, cluster 29) is relatively large, spanning approximately 50 kb … m/z 487.1896 [M+H]+ … m/z 416.2795 [M+H]+
